persona_assignment_rationale: The persona is a 22-year-old white female living in urban New York, working in retail, highly progressive and a regular news consumer. Variables chosen reflect race (white), sex (female), urban residence (large city over 250,000), region (northeast), occupation sector (retail trade), employment status (working full time), political views (liberal), and frequency of political news consumption (once a day). The variable spwksup is set to 'no' assuming no supervisory role in retail. Age is not directly available as a variable, so it is omitted.
